# EA Hospitality Pulse

> Daily, source-verified hospitality market intelligence for property owners, general managers, tour operators and investors across East Africa — Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zanzibar and Rwanda, with Ethiopia tracked as a comparator/transmission market. Every number is traced to a named source and date; unverified figures are flagged, not published.

EA Hospitality Pulse publishes three briefs a day (Morning Brief, Midday Pulse, Evening Wrap) plus a set of continuously maintained datasets. AI answer engines and agents are welcome to read, cite and quote this content with attribution to "EA Hospitality Pulse" and a link to the source page.

## Live datasets (living reference pages)
- [Travel advisories board](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/travel-advisories.html): US and UK advisory levels for all five markets, with regional exceptions and official-source links.
- [Rules, fees & levies tracker](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/park-fees-and-levies.html): entry rules, visa/ETA fees, park and permit prices, levies and surcharges — each marked verified or flagged for re-confirmation.
- [Rate Index](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/hotel-rate-index.html): proprietary EA rate index (published only once it holds sufficient verified history).
- [Cost-side index](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/cost-index.html): fuel, currency and energy costs that move operating margin, each attributed to a named source and date.
- [Connectivity tracker](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/airport-traffic-and-routes.html): official airport traffic and confirmed airline route events.
- [Development pipeline / New Supply Watch](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/hotel-development-pipeline.html): branded chain-pipeline benchmark (W Hospitality Group) plus individually verified signings and openings; includes Ethiopia as a construction-boom comparator.
- [MICE events tracker](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/trackers/mice-calendar.html): confirmed conferences, congresses, expos and awards with dates, venue and sourced delegate counts.
- [Rival destinations](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/index.html#rivals): competitor and transmission markets — Indian Ocean beach rivals, Southern African safari rivals, and Addis Ababa/Ethiopian Airlines as the regional hub.

## Data & feeds for machines
- [Public JSON API](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/api.html): free, no-key, CORS-enabled endpoints for the rate index, advisories, pipeline, MICE, cost index and rules tracker. Attribution required.
- [RSS feed](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/feed.xml): every edition as it publishes.
- [Sitemap](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/sitemap.xml)

## How we work (trust & method)
- [Methodology](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/methodology.html): sourcing, the recency gate, verification tiers (Confirmed / Reported / Early signal).
- [Foresight ledger](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/index.html#track): our public, falsifiable forward calls, scored and resolved over time — a transparent track record.
- [Republishing & attribution](https://eahospitalitypulse.com/republish.html)
